annotation.evidence_span: All pseudo-header fields MUST appear in the header block before regular header fields.
annotation.interpretation_a: Pseudo-header fields must *completely* precede regular header fields; no regular header field can appear before all pseudo-header fields have been processed.
annotation.interpretation_b: Pseudo-header fields must begin before regular header fields, but regular header fields can be interspersed with pseudo-header fields as long as all pseudo-header fields appear first.
annotation.justification: The phrase "before" is ambiguous. It could mean "completely before" (all pseudo-headers first, then all regular headers) or "begin before" (pseudo-headers start first, but regular headers can be interspersed).
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not specify whether all pseudo-header fields must be contiguous, or if regular header fields can appear between pseudo-header fields as long as the pseudo-header fields come first.
